Theron Shan then contacted the Commander and Torian, directing them to a structure called the [[Tributary]], where the rest of Alliance forces already had gathered. With everyone gathered in one place, the Commander checked on the Alliance personnel, eventually approaching Vette.<ref name="KOTET4" />

[[File:Theron_Shan_aims_blaster.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Theron Shan gathered the Commander and others to the Tributary.]]
The Twi'lek showed the Commander her findings, getting ARIES to reveal a list of planets that the [[Unidentified Iokath species|Iokath creators]] used to test their weapons, which turned out to include Zakuul. Their connection to ARIES was then interrupted by SCORPIO, who was imprisoned at an unknown location and asked the Commander for assistance. Their group's position came under attack from the droids again, and Theron Shan activated the force field that prevented more droids from coming in, but also trapped the Alliance inside. Vette interacted with the technolith again, trying to get ARIES back online, but opening a door deeper into the structure instead. She and the Commander went ahead to explore, eventually locating another technolith. Vette instructed the Commander on how to get the power to open the [[light bridge]] in their way, and explaining that they were in [[Necropolis (Iokath)|Necropolis]], a giant crypt that housed millions of dead.<ref name="KOTET4" />

[[File:Vaylin_and_ARIES.jpg|thumb|250px|right|ARIES questions Valyin while posing as her brother Thexan.]]
SCORPIO contacted the Commander again, and revealed the history of Iokath, explaining that ARIES was controlling everything on Iokath, including their current condition, before a host of droids arrived to prove her right. The Commander and Vette fought off their attackers, but their access to both the technolith and the way they originally came in was blocked, requiring Vette to look for another secret tunnel. On their way back to the group, they came across another holonode, from which SCORPIO contacted the Commander again, alerting them that Vaylin had broken free and had located the Eternal Fleet, before notifying the two about a [[colossus droid]] that prepared to attack them. Vette noticed how the droid was drawing power from energy conduits and the Commander disabled them, allowing them to deactivate the droid just as the rest of the group caught up.<ref name="KOTET5">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=5}}</ref>

[[File:The_Outlander_12.png|thumb|left|250px|The Alliance repairs the colossus droid.]]
Theron Shan realized that even though he was unable to locate the ''Gravestone'', he could still use his cranial implant to remotely pilot the Alliance shuttle that was left in its hangar. To provide themselves with a distraction from the droids outside, the team repaired the colossus droid, leaving the Commander to pilot it against its much weaker, but more numerous brethren, while the rest went to the Tributary roof. The Commander dealt with the droids, but the colossus was damaged, requiring the Commander to eject. With everyone safely aboard the shuttle, Theron took off, but before they could leave, SCORPIO contacted the group again and revealed that ARIES raised an [[Ray shield/Legends|energy shield]] that would destroy any vessel attempting to leave. With ARIES recharging the weapon that incapacitated them in the first place and promising to use it again on a lethal setting, the only way out was to stop ARIES.<ref name="KOTET5" />

[[File:SCORPIO_shoots_ARIES.jpg|thumb|250px|right|SCORPIO saves the Commander from ARIES' last strike.]]
SCORPIO revealed the location of [[ARIES base]] and Theron dropped off Vette and the Commander there to deal with ARIES, while the rest went to reclaim the ''Gravestone''. The Commander and Vette confronted and engaged ARIES, and SCORPIO herself arrived to help defeat him. She then lowered the energy shield and urged the Commander to escape before capacitors on ARIES' weapon overloaded, threatening the cover the entire world with a pulse of deadly radiation. SCORPIO announced her intention to upload her consciousness into the planetary network, essentially becoming one with Iokath. Since this would prevent her from threatening the Alliance or the galaxy again, the Commander allowed her to proceed and SCORPIO thanked them before forever leaving her droid body, while also sending to the Alliance schematics for upgrading the ''Gravestone'' with Iokath technology. The Commander and Vette rushed back to the ''Gravestone'', which just barely escaped to hyperspace before the weapon overloaded, as did Vaylin with most of the Eternal Fleet. Returning to the safety of Odessen, Beniko assured the Commander that the Alliance was stronger than ever, with ''Gravestone'' secure and SCORPIO out of the picture, but Iokath remained inaccessible for the time being.<ref name="KOTET5" />

====Operation Dragon's Maw====
[[File:Vaylin_at_the_party.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Commander and Theron crash Vaylin's Grand Festival.]]
An opportunity to strike against Vaylin directly presented itself when Theron located an inside man on Zakuul. [[Indo Zal]], an Alliance sympathizer and Vaylin's [[Magistrate of Revelry]], informed the Commander about the upcoming [[Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin]], where the Empress planned to execute a host of [[Zakuulan rebels]]. Theron vouched for Indo, who proposed to provide disguises and security clearances for the Alliance to infiltrate the party, then cause a revolt among the prisoners, causing enough chaos for the Commander to get close to Vaylin and activate her conditioning. Theron volunteered to accompany the Commander inside the [[Palace of the Eternal Dragon]], while Lana and T7-O1 provided remote support from a shuttle that served as their getaway vehicle. Arriving on Zakuul under the guises of two Knights of Zakuul, Theron and the Commander got inside the Palace and met Indo, who provided them with [[Ion charge/Legends|Ion charges]] to be installed throughout the Palace so that they could be detonated at once and disable the rebels' [[Shock collar/Legends|shock collars]].<ref name="KOTETChapter6">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=6}}</ref>

[[File:Redeemed_Arcann.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Arcann asks to join the Commander's side.]]
Theron and the Commander worked their way around Palace security, planting all six charges, after which Lana informed them that Vaylin was beginning her speech. Dropping their disguises, Theron and the Commander strolled into the main hall, where the Commander triggered the ion charges and activated Vaylin's conditioning, making her powerless to retaliate. However, their confrontation with Vaylin was interrupted by Arcann, who arrived with a group of his loyalists, intending to reclaim the Eternal Throne from his sister. Before retreating from the scene, Vaylin dropped the rebel prisoners and Indo Zal into the creature pit, and Theron and the Commander had to follow inside. After killing a [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] named [[Junior (rancor)|Junior]], the Commander ordered Indo to retreat with the rebels, after which they and Theron went after Vaylin, who was fighting her brother on the balcony.<ref name="KOTETChapter6" />

[[File:Arcann_comes_to_Odessen.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The former Emperor joins the Alliance.]]
The arrival of Theron and the Commander interrupted the duel between siblings, allowing Vaylin to escape on a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]]. To Commander's surprise, Arcann was indeed healed on Voss and addressed them peacefully, no longer consumed by hate and anger. After Theron doubted his trustworthiness, Arcann assisted him and the Commander in the fight against the Horizon Guards who arrived to kill them. Arcann then offered to join the Alliance to atone for the blood shed under his reign, and the Commander agreed to take him in. Enraged at her brother's betrayal, Vaylin ordered the Eternal Fleet to bombard the entire Palace to rubble, and Lana arrived with the shuttle just in time to get the Commander, Theron and Arcann to safety. Upon their return to Odessen, Arcann was initially treated as enemy by the Alliance personnel, many of whom suffered under his rule for years and joined the Alliance to oppose him in a first place. However, the Commander insisted that having the former Eternal Emperor on the side was good for both the morale and for putting additional pressure on Vaylin.<ref name="KOTETChapter6" />

====Into the void====
[[File:Valkorion_reveals_Nathema.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Valkorion reveals the existence of Nathema to the Commander.]]
The bond between the Commander and Valkorion was growing stronger, allowing the Commander to glimpse Valkorion's memories of Vaylin's return to Zakuul after her conditioning on [[Nathema]], and Valkorion suggested that Vaylin may have found a way to break her bonds in the place they were created. Vaylin had indeed vanished and Arcann confirmed that Nathema was a planet in the [[Chorlian sector/Legends|Chorlian sector]], from where a transmission to Vaylin was detected during the Festival. With all signs pointing that Vaylin did indeed return to Nathema, Arcann stayed to watch over still comatose Senya, while the Commander, Theron and Lana went to stop his sister. Theron piloted the shuttle to Nathema, and Lana began feeling the effects of the Force void before even setting foot on the planet. Even Valkorion found his power diminished in this place, though he promised to shield the Commander and Beniko from its worst effects.<ref name="KOTETChapter7">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=7}}</ref>

[[File:Jarak_escaping.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Jarak helps the Commander and Lana escape the spreading influence.]]
Making their way through the planet's surface, left lifeless ever since the [[Ritual of Nathema]] over a millennia ago, the Commander and Beniko reached the [[Sanitarium]], the only structure still showing signs of life on the planet, with Vaylin already inside. Dispatching several Horizon Guards, [[Nathema Zealot]]s and [[Keeper (Nathema)|Keepers]], the two explored the inner workings of the Sanitarium, learning about Vaylin's past there from holorecording left by Anomid named [[Jarak]]. Meanwhile, the ritual to break Vaylin's bonds when out of control, with Vaylin's power vaporising those in her vicinity and Beniko and the Commander came upon Jarak, who offered to take them to a place where they could take shelter. In the Sanitarium's lower levels they reached the [[Emperor's Vaults|Immortal Emperor's Vault]], where Valkorion stored artifacts even he deemed too dangerous, and barely got inside in time.<ref name="KOTETChapter7" />

[[File:Dramath_inside_the_Holocron.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Commander finds Dramath's spirit.]]
With not even Valkorion having a power inside and finding the door stuck, Beniko and the Commander went to activate the backup power generator, while Jarak was killed by a Vault Guardian. Inside, the Commander and Lana made an important discovery of [[Dramath's holocron]], which still housed the essence of Valkorion's father that he killed over 1300 years ago. [[Dramath]] told them that the [[holocron]] held the power to destroy Vitiate once and for all and the Commander ordered Beniko to take care of it, since as soon as they stepped outside Valkorion would have access to the Commander's body once again. Eventually unlocking the door that trapped them inside and defeating several [[Voreclaw]]s, the two learned from Theron that Vaylin had already left the surface and escaped the Sanitarium, which now threatened to collapse. The Commander and Lana rushed outside, where Theron picked them up, but before they could rest, they learned from Bey'wan Aygo that Vaylin launched another [[assault on Odessen]].<ref name="KOTETChapter7" />

====Vaylin's downfall====
[[File:Senya_after_coma.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Senya rejoins the Commander after waking from her coma.]]
Returning to Odessen, the Commander, Theron and Lana found the battle already raging on multiple fronts. Theron volunteered to sneak behind the enemy's lines, while Lana and the Commander made their way to the ''Gravestone'', which was still in dry dock, unable to take off until the Iokath upgrades were completed. Commandeering an [[Eternal Empire Walker]], the Commander and Lana made their way through the front lines, eventually meeting Arcann and awoken Senya Tirall at the ''Gravestone'', as it was finally able to take off. Lana went to join Theron, while the mother and son pledged their support for the Alliance cause once more and offered to stand by the Commander's side against Vaylin.<ref name="KOTETChapter8">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=8}}</ref>

[[File:The_Outlander_15.png|thumb|right|250px|Valkorion urges the Commander to finish Vaylin.]]
The Commander contacted Vaylin via a holo-call, successfully taunting her to abandon the safety of her flagship and travel to Odessen surface for a face-to-face confrontation. Holding an Alliance member hostage, Vaylin awaited on the Alliance landing platform as the Commander and Vaylin's family arrived to stop her. Her power raging out of control, Vaylin killed her hostage and caused a massive [[Force storm (weather)|Force Storm]], leaving the Commander no choice but to strike her down. As Vaylin lay dead, Senya and Arcann lamented her loss, but were relieved that the conflict was over. The fighting on Odessen was over as Zakuulan forces surrendered en masse, but the war was not, as with Eternal Throne empty the GEMINI Captains had gone rogue, bombarding the capital worlds of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Dromund Kaas and Zakuul into rubble. With claiming the Eternal Throne as the only way to stop the destruction, the Alliance leadership departed for Zakuul.<ref name="KOTETChapter8" />

====Taking the Eternal Throne====
[[File:Eternal_Fleet_blockade_of_Zakuul.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Eternal Fleet blockade above Zakuul]]
Catching some sleep on their way, the Commander experienced a vision of the Eternal Throne surrounded by their allies and Vaylin, who rose from the dead to strike them down. Waking up, the Commander ordered Lana to bring Dramath's holocron along, and Valkorion intervened again, dismissing it as a useless dusty trinket. Everyone then gathered on the bridge, where after dropping out of hyperspace, they witnessed the Spire blockaded by the Eternal Fleet, though Iokath upgrades of the ''Gravestone'' allowed Koth Vortena to breach the blockade. Senya and Arcann volunteered to accompany Commander to the Eternal Throne and together they traveled down to surface in a boarding pod that landed in the [[Garden of Izax]]. The three of them made their way to the Spire as the Eternal Fleet burned Zakuul around them, receiving unexpected assistance from Indo Zal and his Zakuulan rebels.<ref name="KOTETChapter9">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=9}}</ref>

[[File:Arcann_and_Senya_in_Eternal_Throme_Room.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Arcann and Senya accompany the Commander to the Eternal Throme room.]]
Fighting through the skytroopers and Knights of Zakuul, they finally took a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] to the Eternal Throne, but Valkorion tried to seed doubt in the Commander's mind, telling him to strike down Senya and Arcann to avoid any competition for the Throne, though the Commander refused. After entering the Eternal Throne room, Arcann was taken aback at seeing his old Throne and lamented the death of millions he caused while holding it, while Senya assured him that he became a better man since then. The Commander took the Throne, which sent a shock through their body and pacified the Fleet. Senya congratulated them, but immediately afterwards Valkorion revealed his ultimate goal, forcing the Commander to kneel and proclaiming his desire to eradicate the Commander's mind and take possession of their body, shocking them into nothingness.<ref name="KOTETChapter9" />

[[File:The_Outlander_16.png|thumb|left|250px|The Commander in Valkorion's form]]
The Commander awoke inside their own mindscape, where they previously conversed with Valkorion during their carbonite sleep. However, the Commander was now wearing Valkorion's skin in a subconscious attempt to save their identity from being completely erased. Traversing the bizarre mindscape, the Commander cleansed their corrupted memories, realizing that Valkorion only pretended to abandon their body on Odessen and later absorbed Vaylin's spirit after her death, giving the Immortal Emperor the key he needed to conquer his vessel's mental defenses. Locating the mental image of Dramath's holocron, the Commander regained their identity, and Valkorion once again manifested in his usual image.<ref name="KOTETChapter9" />

[[File:Vaylin_is_released.jpg|thumb|250px|right|The Commander uses Dramath's holocron to free Vaylin from her father's control.]]
The Commander tried to resist and Valkorion summoned Vaylin's enslaved spirit, placing her under his spell and commanding his daughter to destroy the Commander. The Commander battled Vaylin in the mental mindscape and prevailed, but Valkorion easily restored her spirit, after which the Commander used the representation of Dramath's holocron to free Vaylin from her father's mind control. At this point, Arcann has joined them inside the Outlander's mind by using the physical holocron located in the Eternal Throne room. The Commander and Arcann convinced Vaylin to join them against Valkorion, and the three of them attacked the Immortal Emperor. After toying with them for a while, Valkorion destroyed the holocron, claiming that nothing could stop him.<ref name="KOTETChapter9" />

[[File:Valkorions_last_attack.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Valkorion lashes at the Commander for the last time.]]
However, since his spirit was now bound to Vaylin's and shared her weakness, the Commander used the phrase "Kneel before the Dragon of Zakuul" to turn the tables on Valkorion and rob the Emperor of his own strength. With Valkorion overpowered and weakened, Senya joined her children in the Outlander's mind and together the family watched the Immortal Emperor's final words and moments, until the Commander put a final end to his millennia-long existence. Back in the physical world, Senya congratulated the Commander on finally putting an end to Valkorion and opened a system-wide holochannel to announce the Alliance victory. The Commander then proclaimed the age of the Eternal Alliance, unifying the military of Zakuul and the Eternal Fleet with the cause of the Alliance, with the Eternal Throne moved to Odessen and the Eternal Fleet now under their control.<ref name="KOTETChapter9" />

===The Eternal Alliance===
====Return to Iokath====
[[File:The_Outlander_17.png|thumb|right|250px|Malcom and Acina address the Commander.]]
When the radiation levels on Iokath had subsided, Lana led an Alliance team to claim it for the Alliance. She contacted the Commander and Theron with a status report, which was interrupted by arrival of Imperial and Republic forces on Iokath, who were [[War on Iokath|fighting]] for control over the superweapon. The Commander summoned the Eternal Fleet to Iokath, where contact with it was mysteriously blocked and Theron suggested to look for the source of the transmission on Iokath. After landing, Theron and the Commander went to the [[Fleet Spire]] to meet with Lana, who held two emissaries send by the Republic and the Empire&mdash;Captain [[Elara Dorne]] and Major [[Malavai Quinn]]&mdash;captive. Quinn represented Empress Acina, while Dorne was working [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] [[Jace Malcom]]. Both sides arrived on Iokath looking to claim the superweapon and both pleaded to the Commander to join forces against the other.<ref name="Forgotten">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|The Forgotten World|Iokath}}</ref>

[[File:Supreme_Commander_Jace_Malcom_on_Iokath.jpg|thumb|250px|left|The Commander joined the Republic forces led by Supreme Commander Jace Malcom.]]
The Commander chose to ally with the Republic and helped defend their base against the Imperial assault,<ref name="Shots">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Shots Fired|Iokath}}</ref> after which the Commander and Theron went into a weapons cache to retrieve Iokath weapons and knowledge on how to use them. Theron downloaded the files from an ancient console, learning that the superweapon was powerful enough to wipe all organic life on Iokath in distant past, in addition to ten trillion lives on other planets. When they reunited with Lana, she revealed to the Commander that the conflict was orchestrated by an unknown outside force, which leaked identical data regarding the superweapon to all three parties, luring them all to the same place at the same time. Since the Eternal Throne's control over the Eternal Fleet could only be sabotaged by an Alliance member, Lana suspected a traitor in their ranks.<ref name="Arsenal">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|The Lost Arsenal|Iokath}}</ref>

[[File:Empress_Acina_is_rejected.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Sith Empress Acina's offer was rejected, which led to her death.]]
The Commander and Theron moved to prevent the superweapon's activation by Empress Acina, but they were unsuccessful, and the legendary [[Six Gods]] were awakened. With the control over the Eternal Fleet restored, Theron stayed behind to delay the superweapon activation, while the Commander went inside superweapon command point, assuming an Iokathi throne and witnessing [[Tyth]], the first of Six Gods. Tyth revealed that a close companion of the Commander's was responsible for starting the war and awakening the Six Gods, hinting it to be someone consumed with anger and despair.<ref name="Showdown">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Showdown on Iokath|Iokath}}</ref> While the Commander was plugged in, the Throne was sabotaged, and the Commander ordered the Eternal Fleet to fire on the droid, knocking it out of commission. The Commander was brought back to the Fleet Spire to recuperate, where with no way to narrow down the list of suspects, Lana asked them to approve full-time surveillance by an independent party, which Theron strongly opposed.<ref name="Machines">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Facing the Machines of War|Iokath}}</ref>

====Crisis on Umbara====
[[File:The_Outlander_18.png|thumb|left|250px|The Umbaran hovertrain]]
Eventually Lana found a trail of the traitor that led to the shadow-world of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], where a transmission with the same encryption as the one from Iokath was detected from a [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] with a large stockpile of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]]. Lana Beniko, Theron Shan and the Commander [[Crisis on Umbara|travelled]] there and boarded the speeding train to intercept and stop the traitor, who was supposedly in the control cabin of the locomotive. After defeating an [[Umbaran Shadow Assassin]], the three reached the empty cockpit of the train, where Theron revealed himself as the traitor. He locked the Commander and Lana inside the cabin and sabotaged the train's tracks, which would cause the train to crash into the side of a mountain, vaporizing the Commander, Lana, and the crystals. Bailing before the impact and surviving the crash, the Commander and Lana went after Theron on foot, while also fending off local wildlife. They caught up with Theron, but were unable to stop him before his shuttle left Umbara and were forced to contend with an [[Umbaran Spider Tank]] which covered Theron's escape. Returning to Odessen empty-handed, the Commander sent a galaxy-wide message on the HoloNet, speaking directly to Theron in regards to his treason, and ordered Beniko to use every resource at the Alliance's disposal to locate Theron.<ref name="Crisis">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|Crisis on Umbara}}</ref>

====A traitor among the Chiss====
[[File:Zenta_is_defeated.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Syndic Zenta admits her defeat.]]
The Commander's message reached the right ears and [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Saganu]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] arrived to Odessen personally, revealing that Theron was being sheltered on [[Copero/Legends|Copero]] by the rogue [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Zenta]] of the [[Inrokini family]]. To avoid a political conflict, Saganu asked the Commander to deal with the traitor personally, sending a Human [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Raina Temple]] with them to watch for [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] interests. Arriving on Copero, the Commander and Temple fought their way through the [[Copero City]], eventually engaged Zenta in combat Zenta inside her [[Inrokini Stronghold|starship factory]].<ref name="Chiss">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|A Traitor Among the Chiss}}</ref>

[[File:The_Outlander_19.png|thumb|left|250px|Theron and Valss locate the map on Copero.]]
Defeated and subdued, the Syndic explained that Theron had betrayed her as well, using her [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] relative [[Valss]] to steal the location of a [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] by slicing into her personal datapad. The map had long been kept in secret on Copero and led to a superweapon of the Sith Emperor Vitiate. Having learned Theron's location, the Commander was about to continue their pursuit, but Saganu demanded that they take Zenta's life, claiming there would be no deal between the Alliance and the Ascendancy otherwise. Shan destroyed the holomap after learning the superweapon's location, but as he and Valss prepared to leave, the Commander and Temple arrived to stop them. Valss stayed behind to buy Shan enough time to escape, and the Commander struck the Chiss down, again returning to Odessen without Theron, although impressed by what she had witnessed, Raina Temple volunteered to stay with the Alliance.<ref name="Chiss" />

====Chasing Zildrog====
[[File:Lana_Beniko_on_Abandoned_listening_post.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Lana Beniko recognizes Theron's message by his encryption key.]]
Smugglers working for Hylo Visz eventually intercepted a message to the Alliance from an [[Abandoned listening post|Abandoned Listening Post]] and the Commander went there with Lana to personally investigate it. They discovered that the abandoned station served as the [[Order of Zildrog]]'s base of operation for months, and that the Order was able to watch the Alliance that whole time despite the regular security sweeps on Odessen. Holorecordings revealed that the Order was led by former Horizon Guard [[Vinn Atrius]], who planned to awaken another [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] from Iokath called [[Zildrog]] and use it against Odessen. However, a message entered just before their arrival also revealed a set of coordinates on Nathema, which Lana recognized as coming from Theron due to the unique encryption they developed together on Rishi. Forced to flee as the [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]] was activated and completely obliterated the station, Lana and the Commander returned to Odessen just when the work of restoring the holomap from Copero was finished, revealing a location on Nathema that matched the coordinates left by Theron.<ref name="Nathema">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|The Nathema Conspiracy}}</ref>

[[File:Theron_Shan_surrenders_to_Lana_Beniko.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Theron Shan surrenders to Lana Beniko and the Commander.]]
To stop the Order's plan and deal with Theron one way or another, the Commander and Lana [[Mission to Nathema (Zildrog)|traveled to Nathema]], where they were shocked to see once lifeless world overgrown with plant life. After dealing with several Nathema Zealots and escaped beasts from the Sanitarium, they reached the coordinates, where Theron approached them and revealed himself to be secretly working for the Alliance's interests the whole time. Everyone agreed that the Order should be stopped, and Theron led Lana and the Commander towards the Emperor's Vault under an ancient [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]], where Zildrog was located. When they reached the Vault, Vinn Atrius and [[GEMINI 16]] were already in the process of awakening Zildrog. Theron shot Atrius, but GEMINI 16 trapped the three of them in a [[force field]] and finished summoning Zildrog, allowing it to remotely take over the ''Gravestone'' that remained parked on Odessen.<ref name="Nathema" />

[[File:Vinn_Atrius_on_Nathema.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Vinn Atrius, the mastermind behind the Order of Zildrog]]
Controlling it through the Dark Sanctuary, Zildrog took the ''Gravestone'' into Odessen's orbit and repeatedly fired the omnicannon at the Eternal Fleet, which sat defenseless in the absence of orders from the Throne. Hylo Visz contacted the Commander and informed them of the crisis, but they, Lana and Theron were unable to do anything to stop Zildrog from completely annihilating the Eternal Fleet. Zildrog then targeted Odessen itself, but needed to recharge before the next attack, forcing GEMINI 16 to engage the Alliance directly. Lana, Theron and the Commander destroyed the last remaining GEMINI droid, and Theron attempted to shut Zildrog down, but was stabbed in the back by Vinn Atrius with a [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pike]]. Atrius then ordered Zildrog to augment him with its power and attacked Lana and the Commander with his new increased strength.<ref name="Nathema" />

[[File:Vinn_Atrius_boosted_by_Zildrog.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Zildrog empowers Vinn Atrius.]]
The two defeated Atrius and destroyed Zildrog, which also caused the self-destruct of the ''Gravestone'' and disabled the Eternal Throne. The Commander decided Atrius' fate while Lana tended to Theron's wounds, determining that he needed to be immediately brought to Odessen for treatment. Back on Odessen, Lana reported to the Commander that although Odessen suffered minimal damage with no casualties to Alliance personnel, the ''Gravestone'' and the Eternal Fleet, two of Eternal Alliance's greatest weapons were gone.<ref name="Nathema" /> Without them, the Alliance no longer possessed the military force to rival that of the Republic and the Sith Empire, who redoubled on their preparations for the inevitable renewal of open hostilities. Additionally, many Alliance members chose to leave and rejoin their original factions, their goal of toppling the Eternal Empire accomplished.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Alliance Update - State of the Galaxy}}</ref>

===Third Galactic War===
====Invasion of Ossus====
[[File:Darth_Malgus_reappears_on_Ossus.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Malgus reemerges on Ossus.]]
Following the [[Third Galactic War|renewed conflict]] between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire, the Commander decided to take part in the war. After discussing with Lana on which galactic power the Alliance should side with, the Commander traveled to the [[Slippery Slopes Cantina]] on Nar Shaddaa to meet with Jonas Balkar from the Republic to arrange an alliance, where they learned of a planned Imperial [[Invasion of Ossus|attack]] on a hidden [[Jedi Colony]] on the planet of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. The Commander traveled to Ossus and fought alongside the Jedi and Republic forces, eventually participating in the assault on the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]]. During the conflict, [[Darth Malgus]], believed to have been dead, revealed himself during the invasion and attempted to raze the colony, though the Republic was able to send reinforcements to stop his forces on time.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=other|Jedi Under Siege}}</ref>

====Objective Meridian====
After [[Attack on a Sith Empire fleet|assisting]] in a space battle,<ref name="Tide of War">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|The Tide of War|Carrick Station}}</ref> the Commander was summoned back to the Republic fleet, where he learned of the [[Meridian Complex]] and the Empire's plan to annihilate it. The Commander participated in numerous battles on both [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]<ref name="Palace Intrigue">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|Palace Intrigue|Onderon}}</ref> and [[Mek-Sha]], which they were ambushed at the latter by a masked Force user. During the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]], the Commander themselves led the charge to the complex. As the battle concluded, the Commander escaped the complex in a shuttle.<ref name="Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref>

====Tenebrae's plague====
[[File:Kira_and_Scourge_approach_Commander.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kira and Scourge approach the Commander.]]
After the battle, the Commander returned from Corellia and met with Supreme Chancellor [[Galena Rans]], who offered them the opportunity to join [[Task Force Nova]], a joint military-civilian initiative designed to help rebuild the Jedi Order, with a guarantee that the Eternal Alliance would join the Galactic Republic with Odessen as its member world and its own senator. The Commander accepted after some consideration, and the Alliance was officially integrated into the Galactic Republic. Afterwards, the Commander was approached by [[Scourge (Sith)|Lord Scourge]], formerly the [[Emperor's Wrath]], and Jedi Knight [[Kira Carsen]], a former [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]]. The two both revealed that Scourge was the one who attacked the Commander on Mek-Sha to try and confirm The Commander was free from Tenebrae's influence. The three returned to Odessen, where Scourge and Carsen revealed that while the Outlander was combating Tenebrae on Zakuul, the two of them destroyed his original body, allowing the entity to be truly destroyed. However, in their haste, they accidentally unleashed a Sith plague. Though their bond to the former emperor prevented them from being infected, it still rendered them comatose until Satele Shan and her followers rescued them. However, they became infected themselves, merging into a hivemind. In order to prevent more people falling to this illness, Scourge and Kira refined them to a transport and programed it to fly an undetermined course through unsettled sectors of the Outer Rim. They also revealed that the vessel would eventually return to civilized space, and that they and the Commander would have to be prepared once it finally arrived. Until then, Scourge and Kira pledged themselves to the Commander.<ref name="Onslaught" />

====Uncovering secrets====
[[File:Darth_Malgus_is_captured.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Darth Malgus is captured.]]
Around [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="LotS Date">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref> the Sith Empire invaded the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] planet [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] in an attempt to seize its valuable [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] to turn the tide of the war in their favor while fending off Republic forces supporting the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] to thwart the Empire's plans.<ref name="Dead in the Water">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Republic|Dead in the Water|Manaan}}</ref> At the same time, the rogue Sith Lord Darth Malgus traveled to the [[Temple of Nul]] on the planet [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]]. Jedi Master [[Denolm Orr]] then assembled a team, including his Padawan [[Sa'har Kateen]], to [[Mission to Elom|investigate]] the connection between Malgus and Elom.<ref name="Mission Abstract">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20211001-0|text=Mission Abstract: Investigate link between Darth Malgus and the planet Elom|int=Mission Abstract: Investigate link between Darth Malgus and the planet Elom}}</ref> After a confrontation, Malgus later encountered the Commander, Tau Idair, and Lana Beniko who had just arrived on Elom and was later defeated and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] aboard [[Carrick Station]]. Meanwhile, Sa'har survived the destruction of the temple and found [[Darth Nul's holocron]] that Malgus had hidden and escaped the planet.<ref name="Ruins of Nul">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=flashpoint|Ruins of Nul}}</ref>

====Showdown on Ruhnuk====
[[File:Mandalore_the_Avenger_on_Ruhnuk.jpg|thumb|220px|left|Mandalore the Avenger scouts the Hidden Chain defenses.]]
Some time later, [[Mandalore the Avenger]] contacted the Commander about the information on [[Heta Kol]], leader of the [[Hidden Chain]] splinter faction. She shared that the Hidden Chain operated on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet [[Ruhnuk]] and had put [[Jekiah Ordo]] and her fleet on standby. After arriving on Ruhnuk, the Commander and Shae learned that the Hidden Chain had a relay station for communications that could cut through interference surrounding the planet.<ref name="A Rock and a Hard Place">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|A Rock and a Hard Place|Odessen}}</ref> They later confronted Sa'har Kateen at the [[Ruhnuk Communications Tower]], the Commander attempted to reason with her, but Shae opened fire and Sa'har escaped. The Commander and Shae Vizla dealt with the relay station before heading to locate Heta Kol. Upon arriving at a compound, the Commander was incapacitated by four [[sonic disruptor]]s, leaving them vulnerable. Meanwhile, Shae was separated when the doors closed, and she soon found herself facing [[Dar'manda]] leader [[Bask Sunn]] and Heta Kol. Despite being temporarily helpless due to the sonic weapons, the Commander's situation became a turning point when Shae challenged Heta Kol to a one-on-one duel, hoping to turn the tide.<ref name="Ruhnuk">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|Ruhnuk}}</ref>

[[File:Showdown_on_Ruhnuk.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Shae Vizla is paralyzed by Bask Sunn's sonic weapons.]]
During the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk|challenge]], Shae initially gained the upper hand, but Bask Sunn secretly used a sonic disruptor to paralyze her, giving Heta an opening to attack. The Commander, however, destroyed the sonic disruptor, freeing Shae from its effects and allowing her to recover. With the disruptor gone, Shae was able to overpower Heta, securing a hard-fought victory in front of the Hidden Chain. The celebration was short-lived as the arrival of both fleets signaled the beginning of a full-scale battle. The Hidden Chain retreated from Ruhnuk to an unknown location, while Jekiah ordered the Alliance fleet to refrain from pursuing. The Commander and Jekiah then assisted Shae in retreating from the battlefield. Shae was taken to a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical facility]] where medical droids attended to her injuries. Despite her victory, Shae remained tight-lipped about Heta's covert use of the sonic disruptor. She stated her hunt was still on-going, with her rivalry with Heta far from finished. As word of Shae's triumph spread across the galaxy, the Commander and Jekiah discussed its implications for the Alliance.<ref name="Ruhnuk" />

====Malgus's plans====
[[File:Darth_Malgus_in_Old_Wounds.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Malgus accepts the Alliance Commander as his equal.]]
After the Showdown on Ruhnuk, the Commander met with Darth Malgus once again in the prison to discuss about Darth Nul. Malgus claimed that he knew every secret of Darth Nul's and that the Commander would have discovered the same truths in time. When the Commander asked about his partnership with Heta Kol, Malgus dismissed her claiming that his goals went far beyond her war. He went on to criticize the Mandalorians, labeling them useless and weak. Later, the Commander witnessed Malgus's taunting of Shae Vizla. Malgus mocked Vizla's failure to kill Heta Kol on Ruhnuk and how Heta Kol continued to grow stronger. He predicted that Heta Kol would eventually kill Vizla. When Vizla demanded to know Heta Kol's location, Malgus remained silent. After Vizla left, Malgus's attention turned to the Alliance Commander. He stated that the only person who could truly understand him was the Commanderand stated that it was a shame they would remain adversaries, watching the Commander leave his prison without further word.<ref name="Old Wounds 1">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|Carrick Station}}</ref>

After leaving the prison, the Commander was contacted by [[Sana-Rae]], who had been summoned by the [[Three]] to learn about a terrible prophecy and told the Commander to meet her at the given coordinates. Upon arriving on Voss, the Commander was greeted by Arcann and mentioned that Sana-Rae hadn't told the Commander he would be there but Arcann said it had likely slipped her mind. Later, Sana-Rae revealed the origins of one of Darth Nul's relics. She explained that Nul possessed a unique ability that she could connect her mind to others. Nul could mentally bond with any [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] and awaken those who were unaware of their own potential. She took her followers to [[Unidentified Wild Space planet|an empty world]] in Wild Space, where she taught them to forge these mental bonds. However, Nul made a dangerous mistake by contacting [[Tenebrae|the Sith Emperor]], who ruthlessly pursued her. Before the Emperor could capture her, Nul hid every secrets she could. Despite her efforts to fight back, the Emperor twisted the minds of Nul's followers, turning them into his servants and eventually, she became known as Darth Nul. The Commander asked what Nul had been before her fall to the dark side. Sana-Rae answered that she had been "no one" after being expelled from the Jedi Order. The Commander added that everytime they learn something about Nul it added more pieces to the puzzle but still didn't explain what Nul did to inspire Darth Malgus's plans.<ref name="Old Wounds 2">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|Voss}}</ref>

====Hidden Chain raids====
[[File:Raid on Port Nowhere.jpg|thumb|250px|right|The Raid on Port Nowhere.]]
Around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Chains Date">{{TOR_updates|7.4}}</ref> the Commander and [[Rass Ordo]] traveled to [[Port Nowhere]]. At the same time, Hidden Chain forces led by [[Cantis Bralor]] [[Raid on Port Nowhere|raided]] Port Nowhere to capture [[Prisoner/Legends|hostages]]. The Commander and Rass managed to defeat the attackers and rescue the hostages. Later, Jekiah contacted Rass with intel about the [[Hidden Chain raids|Hidden Chain's raids]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including a [[Raid on Kessan's Landing|planned assault]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="Road to Nowhere">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Road to Nowhere|Port Nowhere}}</ref> The Commander then headed to Ord Mantell, where they met [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jendan Blyes]] of the [[Mantellian Army|Ord Mantell army]]. Blyes had been captured by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Unidentified Black Sun smuggler (Jendan Blyes)|smugglers]], but the Commander freed him. After, Blyes tipped the Commander off about disappearances at [[Kessan's Landing]]. Blyes then reached out to [[Republic High Command/Legends|Republic High Command]] wanting to know when he could expect the rest of reinforcements to Ord Mantell. General [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun|Daeruun]] asked [[Arn Peralun]] to travel to Ord Mantell to investigate the situation. Blyes then reported that one of his scouts had discovered a group of [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatists]] near a [[Geothermal Station|geothermal station]].<ref name="A Helping Hand">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|A Helping Hand|Ord Mantell}}</ref> The Commander and Arn infiltrated the station through its ventilation system, where they met [[Petra Nihrum]], who was searching for her missing sister, [[Mina Nihrum|Mina]]. Petra explained that the Hidden Chain were stealing crates of cooling rods crucial to preventing a meltdown that could blow up half of Ord Mantell. Petra then helped the Commander avert the meltdown of the power plant.<ref name="The Heat is On">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Heat is On|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

[[File:Sahar_Kateen_fights_Tyrus_Brokenblade.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Sa'har Kateen fights Tyrus Brokenblade.]]
Rass Ordo then contacted the Commander to tell that Mandalore had gone missing that no one could find her. The Commander and Petra then headed to an old tram system, where they discovered the trams were heading toward a supply depot at [[Fort Ronnig]].<ref name="The Heat is On" /> At the fort, they encountered [[Nolem Coe]], who was working with the Hidden Chain to transport the hostages off-world. Petra stopped Coe, and the Commander and Petra proceeded to rescue the prisoners, including Mina. After freeing them, they rushed to the hangar, but arrived just in time to see a shuttle carrying the stolen cooling rods take off. Just then, [[Tyrus Brokenblade]] arrived to the hangar bay and confronted the Commander. He was then stopped by Sa'har Kateen, who had secretly traveled to Ord Mantell, intervened just in time to prevent Tyrus from killing Petra.<ref name="Storming the Castle">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Storming the Castle|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

Confronting the leader of [[Clan Varad]], Sa'har dismissed his threat that Heta Kol would kill her for betraying the Hidden Chain. However, when Tyrus hinted that [[Ri'kan Kateen|Ri'kan]] might be the one to execute her. She then worked with the Commander, revealing that the Hidden Chain were attempting to build a machine based on a blueprint from Darth Nul's holocron. After the Commander decided Tyrus's fate, Sa'har commandeered his ship, promising to contact the Commander when she was ready to steal the holocron from Heta Kol.<ref name="Storming the Castle" /> Upon returning, Sa'har overheard Ri'kan discussing a raid by Hidden Chain strike teams, one of which had been [[Raid on the Minboosa District|stranded]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]] after a run-in with the local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]].<ref name="Defiance 1">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Desperate Defiance|Odessen}}</ref>

====Rebellion on Hutta====
Sa'har contacted the Commander, instructing them to travel to [[Mek-Sha]] and locate a code scanner hidden at the [[Slugfall Cantina]]. This scanner would guide the Commander to her hiding spot in the contested gang area, where they could begin their mission.<ref name="Defiance 2">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Desperate Defiance|Mek-Sha}}</ref> Once the Commander arrived at the rendezvous, Sa'har explained that by stealing the holocron, it would complete derail Heta's plans, as the machine she's building can't function without it. She further explained that the machine could reawaken a person's connection to the Force that had been overlooked in the past, which Heta believed could be used to create powerful warriors ready to fight, which was why the Hidden Chain was rounding up prisoners. The only way to infiltrate the [[Hidden Chain flagship]] to rescue the prisoners and destroy the machine was with a special shuttle and she had identified one such ship in the [[Minboosa District]] on Hutta.<ref name="What Bothers Minboosa">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|What Bothers Minboosa|Minboosa District}}</ref>

Learning that the Hutt forces had locked down the district in response to [[Rebellion in the Minboosa District|a slave uprising]], the two came up with a plan to aid the rebel slaves in hopes they would have information on the Hidden Chain shuttle. After a few questionings, they traveled to the [[Shipping Facility|shipping port]], where they interrupted a group of Hidden Chain rounding up prisoners. After killing the Mandalorians and freeing prisoners, their leader, [[Virta]], instructed the two to meet them at the [[Pilot Commissary]], where the freed prisoners asked them to run errands for them while they asked around about the shuttle.<ref name="What Bothers Minboosa" /> After that, Virta informed them that the shuttle was locked in the [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Refining Factory|refinery]] and that the only way to gain access was through the [[Underground Tunnels|underground gas tunnels]].<ref name="The Path Below">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Path Below|Minboosa District}}</ref>

[[File:Adi Vonapa and Rakit.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Adi Vonapa and Rakit meet the Alliance Commander.]]
The Commander and Sa'har infiltrated the refinery, where they got caught up with an all-out battle between the rebel slaves and the Hutt forces. Eventually, they confronted and defeated the captain, [[Griknaz]]. But just as Sa'har started questioning him on the location of the Hidden Chain shuttle, he was killed by a sniper who worked for [[Vobbara Yusinduu]], who accused both the Commander and Sa'har of starting the uprising. Yusinduu ordered them to kill everyone, starting the fighting all over again. During the fighting, a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] named [[Adi Vonapa]] saved the Commander from being attacked from behind and instructed the pair to find his [[Hidden Cave (Minboosa District)|safehouse]] if they wanted information on the shuttle. They meet both him and his fellow rebel leader, [[Rakit]]. As the rebels explained, they were also trying to get into the refinery's hanger, where all the shuttles were docked so they could escape Yusinduu.<ref name="The Path Below" /> The Commander and Sa'har carried out various tasks to clear the way to the hangar, eventually confronting Yusinduu himself piloting a war droid. After defeating Yusinduu, the Commander and Sa'har successfully stole the Hidden Chain shuttle and departed Hutta.<ref name="Out of the Mire">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Out of the Mire|Minboosa District}}</ref>

====Recovering the holocron====
[[File:RikanFacesAgainstSahar.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Ri'kan and Sa'har Kateen fight on the Hidden Chain ship to secure the holocron.]]
The Commander and Sa'har [[Mission to Hidden Chain Ship|traveled]] to the Hidden Chain flagship. They disabled the comms to prevent reinforcements and freed the prisoners in the detention area. The prisoners initially blamed Sa'har for their capture, but the Commander convinced them they were there to help. After escorting the prisoners to the shuttle, they fought their way to the reactor room, where they found the completed [[Holocron Machine]]. Suddenly, Ri'kan ambushed them. Despite Sa'har's attempts to talk to him, he kept attacking, damaging the reactors and activating the Holocron Machine. The battle caused the floor to collapse, sending them into a lower reactor room. The fight continued until an explosion knocked them all apart. Sa'har rushed to help Ri'kan when she saw him hanging from the edge. The Commander helped her save him, and Sa'har grabbed the holocron and passed it to the Commander. But Ri'kan soon recovered, using the Force to immobilize Sa'har just as they tried to escape. Sa'har sealed the doors with her power and told the Commander to flee. As she lost consciousness, she saw Ri'kan standing over her. The Commander attempted to help the siblings but the path was blocked by falling debris forcing the Commander to escape the flagship with the holocron.<ref name="Sundering1">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Sundering|Hidden Chain Ship}}</ref> Meanwhile, Shae Vizla and her mercenaries [[Malgus's escape|broke]] Malgus out of Carrick Station, fearing that Heta Kol's war would provoke both the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire. To prevent the destruction of all [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], Vizla aligned herself with Malgus, the only one capable of stopping Heta Kol.<ref name="Sundering2">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Sundering|Carrick Station}}</ref>

====Rising tensions====
[[File:Malgus destroys scorpions.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Shae Vizla's mercenary team attacks a Hidden Chain base.]]
Sometime after Malgus, Vizla, and her [[Mandalore the Avenger's crew|mercenary team]] [[Attack on a Hidden Chain base|attacked]] a Hidden Chain base on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Arbiter/Legends|Arbiter]] Jekiah Ordo and Rass Ordo arrived on Odessen to discuss the situation. Jekiah suggested locating Shae Vizla, Malgus, or Heta Kol, mentioning that one of Shae's accomplices had turned up on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. He also reported that one of Heta Kol's loyal followers had defected and was hiding on Tatooine. Lana Beniko informed that the Alliance had breached the inner sanctum of Darth Nul's temple on Elom, and a reconnaissance team on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] had discovered the wreckage of the [[Emperor's Fortress]].<ref name="Galactic Threads">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Galactic Threads|Tatooine}}</ref> However, the team on Ilum was later lost, with their last transmission revealing the wreckage of the Emperor's Fortress, and a snowstorm had interfered with their comms.<ref name="Dark Heart of the Fortress 1">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Dark Heart of the Fortress|Odessen}}</ref>

[[File:Emperor Fortress Ruin.jpg|thumb|250px|left|The Commander and Lana Beniko in the ruins of the Emperor's Fortress.]]
The Commander and Lana [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress (Third Galactic War)|traveled]] to Ilum to investigate. They found that the survey team had been wiped out and uncovered recordings of Darth Malgus. They eventually discovered the Emperor's vault, which housed a [[Darth Nul's mind prison|mind prison]] that belonged to Darth Nul. Inside the mind prison, they encountered Darth Nul who explained why the Emperor killed her and what is Malgus's goal. After escaping the mind prison and destroying it, they returned to Odessen. There, they received an encrypted message, already loaded into a console, containing a message from [[Darth Jadus]], once the lifeblood of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. Lana Beniko was shocked, as she had never expected Jadus to be involved in these events.<ref name="TOR:DHotF" />

[[File:Chancellor_Rans_on_Odessen.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Supreme Chancellor Galena Rans, Admiral Barus Rava, and Jedi Master Sal-Deron arrives on Odessen.]]
Sometime after, the Commander received an urgent call from Tau Idair, who warned the Commander that [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Galena Rans]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Barus Rava]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sal-Deron]] had arrived on Odessen. The sudden visit seemed intended to catch the Commander by surprise before they could explain what had been happening. Tau explained that the Republic was struggling with many problems. The Commander asked her to delay the visitors while they met with Lana Beniko, Theron Shan, and T7-O1.<ref name="The Master's Enigma">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Master's Enigma|The [[Enigma (research vessel)|''Enigma'']]}}</ref>

During the meeting, Lana revealed that Darth Jadus had sent an encrypted message to Odessen. T7-O1 had successfully decrypted it and found a set of coordinates. Lana suggested asking the Supreme Chancellor for help in dealing with Jadus before he became a threat. Theron disagreed, believing it would only make their situation more complicated. The Commander and their advisors then met the Republic delegation and were surprised to see a large group of troopers accompanying them. Tensions quickly rose as the Republic blamed Shae Vizla's actions and the worsening Hidden Chain attacks on the Alliance. Chancellor Rans then demanded that the Alliance hand over Darth Nul's holocron.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

Sal-Deron and Admiral Rava immediately accused the Commander of altering the relic to hide its secrets, since the Commander had been the only person with access to it. Chancellor Rans ended the argument and declared that the Commander would be confined to Odessen until Darth Malgus was captured or their innocence was proven. After the Republic leaders left with the holocron, the group decided that the Commander and Tau needed to escape, recover the holocron, and investigate the coordinates that Jadus sent. Lana and Theron guided the Commander through maintenance tunnels on the base. They led the Commander to the cold storage room and told them to wait while T7 used a loader droid to obtain [[Republic trooper]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

Disguised as a Republic soldier, the Commander left the base and met Tau outside. She pointed out that the Commander's ship was being watched, forcing them to steal a shuttle instead. Once they were in space, Tau handed the Commander the recovered holocron. As they approached the Republic fleet, Tau assured the Commander that the shuttle had valid clearance codes and would not attract attention. The plan worked and they jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

[[File:Enigma_planet.jpg|thumb|250px|left|The Commander arrives at Darth Jadus's given coordinates.]]
The Commander and Tau Idair followed Darth Jadus's coordinates to a massive [[research vessel]] known as the [[Enigma (research vessel)|''Enigma'']] hidden above a green [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. After arriving, they were escorted by [[Darth Jadus's power base|Jadus's followers]] to meet the Sith Lord himself. Jadus explained that Heta Kol was close to completing a larger version of Darth Nul's machine, which Darth Malgus intended to seize. He claimed Malgus wanted to spread chaos across the galaxy, while he sought to impose order. Jadus needed Darth Nul's holocron which was linked to the Commander. Jadus sent the Commander and Tau into the lower levels of the ''Enigma'' to unlock the holocron. The Commander then unlocked Darth Nul's personality matrix, unlocking the holocron's full power. The unlocked holocron revealed that Nul's machine had been designed to awaken the Force in billions of beings across the galaxy. It also revealed that [[Khar Shian]] was the best remaining location for the machine after the destruction of the original one on Elom.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

At that moment, Jadus arrived with [[Darth Rivix]] and his followers. He revealed that the Hidden Chain had already built Nul's machine on Khar Shian and declared that the Commander was no longer useful. Suddenly, Tau betrayed the Commander by activating a [[Force field/Legends|forcefield]] that trapped them. She admitted she had made a deal with Jadus in hopes of rescuing Sa'har Kateen. After Jadus left, the Commander escaped the forcefield and pursued him through the ''Enigma''. The Commander defeated Jadus's remaining troops and damaged his shuttle. Arn Peralun, who had secretly followed them, arrived and rescued the Commander. Meanwhile, Jadus escaped with the holocron and went on to Khar Shian.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

====Stopping the Hidden Chain====
After escaping the ''Enigma'', the Commander and Arn Peralun returned to Odessen, where they were immediately confronted by Admiral Rava, Supreme Chancellor Rans, and Jedi Master Sal-Deron. Rava demanded an explanation and warned that otherwise the Commander would be taken to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in chains. Rans stated that the Commander had left her with no other choice, while Sal-Deron asked what had happened to Darth Nul's holocron. Arn argued that punishing those who took action was not a solution. He questioned why everyone was not working together against their common enemies.<ref name="Into the Shadows">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Into the Shadows|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref>

The Mandalorian Trat'ade fleet then arrived on Odessen. Jekiah Ordo and Rass Ordo soon met with the Commander and explained that they had responded as quickly as possible after receiving Lana Beniko's call. Rans initially stated that the Mandalorians were on their own, but Jekiah told her to either help stop the Hidden Chain and Darth Jadus or add more enemies to the Republic's list. Rans then agreed to cooperate with both the Alliance and the Mandalorians.<ref name="Into the Shadows" />

The Commander then headed to the mission briefing room. There, the Commander revealed that Heta Kol had built another version of Darth Nul's machine for Darth Jadus. Jekiah explained that the Hidden Chain had been transporting enough supplies and equipment through [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith space]] to build the machine. Arn added that an [[Naga Sadow's fortress|abandoned fortress]] on the moon could be the location of the machine. General [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun|Daeruun]] warned that the Republic could not commit its full strength because many of its forces were already [[Attack on Vinsoth|engaged]] on [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]]. Jekiah and his Mandalorians agreed to patrol the sector, locate the fortress, and lead the ground assault. Meanwhile, the Commander, Lana Beniko, and Theron Shan would lead an infiltration team to stop Jadus from activating the machine. Daeruun's fleet would support the operation by covering their approach and drawing the enemy's attention away from the infiltration team.<ref name="Into the Shadows" />

[[File:Khar Shian Fleet.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Hidden Chain fleet orbiting Khar Shian]]
The Republic fleet traveled to Khar Shian to [[Battle of Khar Shian|launch an assault]] on the Hidden Chain fleet. Meanwhile, the Commander, Lana Beniko, and Theron Shan infiltrated the moon aboard a stolen Hidden Chain shuttle. Upon arrival, Lana discovered that a powerful shield protected the fortress, preventing the Mandalorians from landing. The shield had to be disabled quickly as they could not stay airborne forever.<ref name="Into the Shadows" /> As the ground operation began, General Daeruun and Arn Peralun board the ''[[Gatalentan Dawn]]'' to destroy the Hidden Chain's [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and [[Missile/Legends|missile pods]]. During the battle, a Republic officer warned Admiral Rava about a massive power surge coming from one of the Hidden Chain cruisers and moments later, an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] struck the [[Endurance (Valor-class)|''Endurance'']].<ref name="The First Hurdle">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The First Hurdle|[[Khar Delba system/Legends|Khar Delba system]]}}</ref>

On the surface, the Commander, Lana, and Theron found Sa'har and Ri'kan Kateen attempting to escape. After defeating [[Shauz Farr|a Hidden Chain commander]], the team then succeeded in deactivating the shield surrounding the fortress. Inside the fortress, the Commander encountered Shae Vizla. Shortly after, Jekiah and Rass Ordo arrived and confronted Vizla about abandoning them. The Commander stopped the argument between them, insisting that they deal with it after the battle. Heta Kol later arrived and attacked them, ending with Heta wounding Shae Vizla before being killed herself.<ref name="Legacy Reborn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Legacy Reborn|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref>

The Commander then went deeper into the fortress and reached Darth Nul's machine. There, the Commander found Darth Malgus at its center, attempting to activate it. Malgus declared that the Commander had arrived too late. Before they could stop him, both the Commander and Malgus became trapped in an illusion created by the [[Sith Meditation Sphere|meditation sphere]]. In the illusion, the Commander fought an illusion of Darth Jadus. After breaking free from the illusion, the Commander discovered that Jadus escaped the moon. Malgus then activated the machine and transmits a message to every Force-sensitive being in the galaxy.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

==Behind the scenes==
The term "[[Outlander]]" is first used to refer to the player character in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] and continues to be used in subsequent updates and [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion. After the player becomes the Commander of the Eternal Alliance, the Alliance personnel starts to refer to the player as "Commander," while [[Zakuulan]]s continue to use the "Outlander" moniker. For the player's backstory with Theron Shan, Lana Beniko and Darth Marr to make sense, the Outlander also must have participated in the events of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] expansion, although during that time the term "Outlander" is never used and each class even has a mission unique to their class on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. The game establishes that all eight original class characters&mdash;[[Hero of Tython]], [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]], [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Meteor]], [[Voidhound]], [[Cipher Nine]], [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]], [[Empire's Wrath]] and [[Darth Nox]]&mdash;disappeared around the start of the [[Eternal Empire conquest]], and any of them can become the Outlander, leading to many class-exclusive lines that refer to the player's past and unique cutscenes when reuniting with original class companions. During the playthrough the player faces multiple light- and dark-side choices, some of them almost inconsequential, while others can change the story significantly, such as killing characters who otherwise survive and continue to play a role in future events. The player can also initiate a romance with Lana Beniko, Theron Shan or Koth Vortena (as well as Arcann in case he is redeemed) regardless of their own gender, or resume their original romance with returning class companion.<ref name="KOTFE" />

===Jedi Under Siege===
In Jedi Under Siege, the player is given the option to choose which faction they wish to side with, regardless of their choice on Iokath. They can either choose to stay loyal to their prior faction, or become a saboteur for the opposite faction. The player will not fight alongside their new allies if they become a saboteur, but they will have the option to perform sabotage missions to weaken their prior faction.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />

===Onslaught===
The opening scene of Onslaught, consisting of a Republic starfighter squadron ambushing a [[Terminus-class destroyer]], varies on the faction chosen:

If the Outlander was Republic, the Outlander leads the fighter squadron in an Alliance shuttle. The destroyer is annihilated by bombers and the captain attempts to flee via shuttle. If the Outlander is loyalist, they'll take out the shuttle's engines and successfully capture the captain. If the Outlander is an Imperial Saboteur, they'll purposefully miss, allowing the captain to flee to hyperpsace.<ref name="Onslaught" />

If the Outlander was Imperial, a trap is placed and a Harrower Dreadnought, along with another Terminus, assists in destroying the fighter squadron. The Outlander leads the Imperial fighters in an [[S-13 Sting]]. One of the Republic pilots attempts to escape. If the Outlander is loyalist, they'll shoot and destroy the fighter. If the Outlander is a Republic Saboteur, they'll fire on the escaping fighter, but only damage it, allowing it to escape.<ref name="Onslaught" />

At the end of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion, a commander who was loyal to their faction is given the choice between rejoining their prior faction, along with the entire Alliance, or remaining independent. However, if the Commander was a saboteur and sabotaged their faction's efforts on Corellia, they won't be invited back into their previous faction.<ref name="Onslaught" />

====Empire gameplay====
Acina revealed to the Commander that she found the Dark Council to be best suited to administrative duties and not critical wartime activities. She then pitched her idea for an organization answering directly to her and the influence was the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]] of the late [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]]. She decided on reforming the organization into "The Hand" and formed from the Empire's best and loyal personnel. Acina's choice would be to recruit the initial ranks from the Eternal Alliance's ranks, have Odessen officially join the Empire and with all Alliance personnel being granted Imperial citizenship.<ref name="Objective Meridian">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Objective Meridian}}</ref>

*If the player is a '''Sith Warrior''', Acina or Vowrawn would restore their rank of [[Emperor's Wrath|Empire's Wrath]] and name them the official leader of the Hand.<ref name="Objective Meridian" />
*If the player is a '''Sith Inquisitor''', Acina or Vowrawn would restore their [[Darth|Sith title]] and Dark Council seat (if they chose to kill [[Darth Anathel|Anathel]] prior to this). Any past holdings would once again be theirs to claim in service of destroying the Empire's enemies.<ref name="Objective Meridian" />
*If the player is an '''Imperial Agent''', Acina or Vowrawn would grant them the rank of Keeper and give them command over covert operations separate from [[Darth Xarion]]'s [[Sith Intelligence]].<ref name="Objective Meridian" />
*If the player is a '''Bounty Hunter''', Acina or Vowrawn would grant them the title of Hunter and would charge them with hunting down and destroying the Empire's enemies.<ref name="Objective Meridian" />
While detailing what the Alliance Commander can reclaim if they rejoin the Empire, Acina does offer that the Alliance Commander can remain where they are and maintain the Alliance's independence if they choose but they would still work with the Hand rather than the Dark Council. If the Commander refuses to rejoin, Acina will express her disappointment and bids the Commander a bitter farewell until called upon.

If Acina was killed on Iokath, then Vowrawn proposes the idea instead with all the same conditions and opportunities.

The Alliance Commander accepts the Empress' or Emperor's proposal and rejoins the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] stating that this is where they truly belong. Acina is most satisfied with the Commander's reply and states that she will begin the necessary preparations and will find a liaison between her and the Commander in Darth Malgus' absence.

====Republic gameplay====
[[Galena Rans|Supreme Chancellor Rans]] revealed to the Commander her dilemma about them being the hero of the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] who's not in the Republic (for some years now). She then invited the Commander back to join the Republic, alongside their allies and planet. Odessen would become a member world of the Republic with a [[senator]], the Commander's people would get clean records and citizenship. Rans and [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun|General Daeruun]] open up about the new Republic initiative to help the Jedi rebuild their order, the joint military and civilian [[Task Force Nova]]. Daeruun would be their liaison to the Task Force or rather with the Republic military – providing security, reconnaissance, and intelligence support.

*If the player is a '''Jedi Knight''', [[Gnost-Dural]] would welcome them as the first member of the rebuilt Jedi High Council and restore their rank of Battlemaster.
*If the player is a '''Jedi Consular''', Gnost-Dural would restore their seat in the Jedi High Council and their title of Master of Hidden Knowledge.
*If the player is a '''Smuggler''', General Daeruun would make them an official “citizen privateer” – separate from the military, but with the effective rank of Commodore and control over all of the Task Force's civilian and logistical aspects.
*If the player is a '''Trooper''', General Daeruun would give them direct command of Task Force Nova's military aspects. They would be reinstated in the Republic Army Special Forces Division at the rank of Colonel.

While detailing what the Alliance Commander can reclaim if they rejoin the Republic, Rans does offer that the Alliance Commander can remain where they are and maintain the Alliance's independence if they choose but they would still be the Republic's top ally and would help with the task force. 

The Alliance Commander accepts the Chancellor's proposal and rejoins the Republic stating that they've been away from the Republic and from the Jedi for too long. Rans is most satisfied with the Commander's reply and states that this will take quite a bit of paperwork.
